### Feasting in a Famine
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/feasting-in-a-famine-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-january-29-2020.html
Passage: 2 Kings 7:9
Points:
- Four starving lepers discovered an abandoned enemy camp filled with abundant food and provisions.
- After satisfying their own hunger, they recognized that keeping this discovery secret was wrong.
- Believers who feast on God's Word should not hoard spiritual truths inside church walls.
- Sharing faith can be as simple and natural as recommending a good restaurant.
- Telling someone about Jesus Christ is the ultimate demonstration of love.
